label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Renee, here's my rundown for the noon meeting. Good week to be writing one.

Game: We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday night, and that locks up 2nd in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before us coaches even met, which tells you what they think of him. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 touchdowns, including a long one in the 3rd quarter. Our line was pushing them 5 yards back that whole drive, best I've seen them block all year. Defense held Brookhollow to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

Playoffs: We're HOME for the first round. We host Clanton Valley this Friday, Nov 13, 7pm at Ridge Field. Ticket presale starts Tuesday. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows it's a home game. I'd love to see the admin team, the board and anybody else who can make it out there.

Grades: The 9 weeks grade check came back clean. All 52 kids on the roster are eligible, nobody on the list. That's Tonya Greer's doing, not mine. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason, and she's keeping it going through the playoffs. If anybody gets credit in the board report, it ought to be her.

Boosters: Final count on the Boston butt sale is 208 butts sold and $6,240 raised. The goal was $4,500. The money goes toward new sideline headsets. Carla Mims posted the final count, and Hargrove's Meat Market did the smoking at cost, so they deserve a thank you too.

Last thing, I haven't forgot about the buses. If we win Friday and go on the road, I'll get the bus stuff to you quick so transportation has their 5 days.

Holler if you need anything else before noon.
